hook_line: This big cat cannot roar, and it may be the reason nobody ever sees it.
intro: This big cat cannot roar, and it may be the reason nobody ever sees it.
facts: Snow leopards live higher than almost any other big cat, hunting on cliffs up to 5,000 meters in the mountains of Central Asia where the air is thin and freezing.
Unlike lions and tigers, they cannot roar, because the structure of their throat is different, so they chuff, hiss, and purr instead.
Their tail is nearly as long as their body, and they wrap it around their face like a scarf to keep their nose warm while sleeping in the snow.
They can leap up to nine meters in a single bound, more than six times their body length, and their huge paws work like natural snowshoes.
outro: The ghost of the mountains, finally explained.
